instruction: A candid athletic photograph in a wide full shot captures an indoor boxing gym. On the left, the man in the orange beanie (R1), wearing a white t-shirt, light blue sweatpants, and white sneakers, stands holding a black punching bag. On the right, the blonde woman in the lavender cropped hoodie (R2), wearing black leggings and black sneakers, punches the bag from a rear-facing angle. Medicine balls rest on the floor behind them. The background features a gray concrete wall with yellow floor trim. Bright, even gym lighting illuminates the scene.
